activity.notes: Frederick II, known as Frederick the Great, succeeded Frederick William I on 31 May 1740 and ruled Prussia until his death on 17 August 1786. ATLAS binds him to the Kingdom of Prussia rather than a generic Germany polity. His titulature was technically King in Prussia until 1772 and King of Prussia thereafter; the normalized role remains King for the continuous sovereign reign.

sources.title: Fürstenmacht und Allianzen in Europa — Deutsches Historisches Museum
